nodes.name: _clear_mapped_tables
nodes.summary: Empties all mapped target tables before loading.

nodes.summary: Inserts all prepared tables in order, returning pending deferred references and row counts.

nodes.summary: Applies deferred foreign-key values after all rows are inserted.

nodes.summary: Resets PostgreSQL sequences for loaded tables using Django's sequence reset SQL.

layers.description: Django ORM models, repository implementations, and composition wiring of bounded contexts.

layers.description: Django views, forms, URL configs, REST and tracking/map adapters exposing the contexts.

layers.name: Templates & UI
layers.description: Django HTML templates for booking wizard, tracking, and admin live map.

layers.name: Schema Migrations
layers.description: Django database migrations per bounded context.

layers.name: Management Commands & Data Migration
layers.description: Management commands, seeding, and data snapshot export/load tooling.

layers.name: Project Bootstrap & Config

tour.title: Project Entry Point & Bootstrap
tour.description: Start at asgi.py, the ASGI entry point that loads settings, then see settings.py and the root urls.py that mount each bounded context. wsgi.py is its synchronous sibling.
tour.languageLesson: Django finds its configuration through the DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE environment variable, which entry points set before building the application.

tour.title: Domain Language: the Glossary
tour.description: The handling GLOSSARY documents the ubiquitous language (cargo, handling event, voyage, location) used throughout the DDD-style code.

tour.title: Cargo Aggregate Root
tour.description: The Cargo aggregate ties together a TrackingId, RouteSpecification, Itinerary and Delivery. These value objects hold the core business rules with no Django dependency.
tour.languageLesson: Value objects are immutable and compared by value, typically built with frozen dataclasses in Python.

tour.title: Supporting Domains: Voyage, Location, Handling, Pathfinder
tour.description: Other bounded contexts model voyages and schedules, UN/LOCODE locations, handling events and attempts, and pathfinder transit paths. Each keeps its own domain package.

tour.title: Repository Ports
tour.description: Domain-layer repository interfaces (Protocols) define persistence needs without naming Django, enabling dependency inversion.
tour.languageLesson: typing.Protocol gives structural typing: any class with the right methods satisfies the port, with no inheritance needed.

tour.title: Application Services: Use Cases
tour.description: Application services orchestrate domain objects: booking registration, routing and destination changes, tracking lookups, handling report acceptance and attempt processing.

tour.title: Infrastructure: ORM Models & Repositories
tour.description: Django ORM records and repository implementations adapt the ports to a PostgreSQL database. The models.py shims re-export records so Django discovers them.

tour.title: Composition Roots
tour.description: composition.py modules wire concrete repositories into services and views, the one place where layers meet.
tour.languageLesson: Composition roots build the object graph manually, a form of dependency injection that needs no framework.

tour.title: Web Interfaces: Booking, Tracking, Handling, Pathfinder
tour.description: Views and URL configs expose the use cases: the booking wizard, the public tracking page with map frame, the admin live map, the REST handling endpoint and the pathfinder API.

tour.title: Templates & HTMX UI
tour.description: Server-rendered templates extend base.html, which loads Tailwind and HTMX. Partials are swapped in by HTMX for the wizard, tracking results and the live map.

tour.title: Management Commands & Data Migration
tour.description: Commands seed sample data, drain queued handling attempts, and export or load data snapshots.
